gpsHistory.accessTitle: GPS history is available to field agents
gpsHistory.accessBody: You are signed in as a manager. Open Team to review employees’ latest accepted locations. “My GPS” history belongs only to a field-agent account.
gpsHistory.title: My GPS history
gpsHistory.subtitle: Only your own server-confirmed points are shown here.
gpsHistory.empty: No GPS points for this day
gpsHistory.emptyHelp: GPS is recorded only during an open workday. Start the day from the Today screen.
gpsHistory.offlineNote: You're offline. The history may not be up to date.
gpsHistory.trackingHint: GPS starts after you open your workday and stops when you end it.
gpsHistory.offlineBody: History for this day has not been loaded before. Connect to the internet and try again.
gpsHistory.timeoutBody: History did not load in time. Tap Try again.
gpsHistory.errorBody: GPS points could not be retrieved. Try again; if this continues, tell your manager.
gpsHistory.retainedOfflineBody: Showing history loaded earlier in this session. It may not be up to date.
gpsHistory.retainedTimeoutBody: Showing the history already loaded. The server did not return fresh data in time.
gpsHistory.retainedErrorBody: Showing data that was loaded earlier in this session.
gpsHistory.routeHint: The line follows real GPS points in time order and breaks where GPS records have a large time gap. It does not claim visits or stops occurred.
gpsHistory.mapUnavailable: The map is unavailable. Your GPS route remains visible on the fallback grid.

gpsHistory.playbackHint: Tap Start to move through the GPS points in chronological order.
gpsHistory.timelineHint: Tap a time to move to that point in the route view.
